title: 流程地图
description: 从触发条件到交接、摩擦点、控制措施和安全改进，梳理一个重复工作流。

blocks.title: 触发条件与结果
blocks.intent: Identify one repeated workflow observed in the selected period. State its source-backed trigger, intended outcome, and the evidence boundary without merging unrelated workflows.

blocks.title: 观察到的步骤
blocks.intent: Map the selected workflow as an ordered sequence of observed steps. Include the application or system and supporting timestamp for each step when available; mark unobserved transitions as unknown.

blocks.title: 人员与交接
blocks.intent: Show source-backed people, roles, systems, or queues involved in the selected workflow and where work changes hands. Do not infer an owner that was not observed.

blocks.title: 摩擦点与瓶颈
blocks.intent: List repeated waits, rework, manual copying, context switching, or error risk observed in the selected workflow. Separate direct evidence from interpretation.

blocks.title: 控制措施与例外
blocks.intent: Map observed review steps, approvals, exception paths, and safety checks in the selected workflow. Keep risky decisions and external writes explicitly human-controlled.

blocks.title: 安全的改进路径
blocks.intent: Recommend the smallest source-backed process improvement or automation trial, including what remains human-approved and how to measure success before expanding it.
